description: Refresh the authenticated viewer image or 3D geometry without consuming tool-call allowance.

background.description: Canvas background for PNG and SVG: any #RRGGBB color, white, black, or transparent. Defaults to opaque white (black when dark=true). Opaque backgrounds automatically select the light/dark drawing palette and override dark.

dark.description: Legacy background choice: true=opaque black, false=opaque white. For transparent output, selects the drawing's light/dark palette.

format.description: Default png. Ask for svg only when the caller needs vector output: model space of a real drawing can emit tens of MB of SVG, which large clients refuse to render.

handle.description: Layout, block or named-view handle, from cad.list_render_views. Required unless view=model.

handles.description: Zoom to these entities (hex handles) instead of giving a region. Model space or block views only.

hideLayers.description: Do not draw these layers. Combines with onlyLayers.

layer.description: Zoom to everything on this layer (case-insensitive).

mode.description: Default 2d. 3d exports model-space GPU geometry for local orbiting.

onlyHandles.description: Draw only these entities (hex handles) of the viewed space; a block reference stands for everything it places. Unlike handles/layer, which only zoom, this hides everything else.

onlyLayers.description: Draw only these layers (names, any case). A view of a few layers is fitted to what remains unless region is given. Layer names come from cad.query_objects or the layers list of cad.show_document.

region.description: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in drawing units. Omit to fit the whole view.

showLineweights.description: Draw stored lineweights. On by default in the viewer.

text.description: Zoom to TEXT/MTEXT containing this string (case-insensitive). Filters combine with AND; ignored if region is set.

viewport.description: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] actually on screen, when region asks for more. Not drawn; remembered as the camera.

name: cad.viewer_render
